title: Chapter 2: The Land of the Munchkins

sentences.text: A sudden shock woke Dorothy from her deep sleep.

translations.en: A sudden shock woke Dorothy from her deep sleep.
translations.fr: Une secousse soudaine réveilla Dorothée de son profond sommeil.
translations.es: Una sacudida repentina despertó a Dorita de su sueño profundo.

sentences.text: The house had stopped moving through the sky.

translations.en: The house had stopped moving through the sky.
translations.fr: La maison avait cessé de bouger à travers le ciel.
translations.es: La casa había dejado de moverse por el cielo.

sentences.text: Bright sunshine filled the open window of the room.

translations.en: Bright sunshine filled the open window of the room.
translations.fr: Un soleil radieux éclairait la fenêtre ouverte de la pièce.
translations.es: La luz brillante del sol llenó la ventana abierta del cuarto.

sentences.text: Toto barked happily and ran to the front door.

translations.en: Toto barked happily and ran to the front door.
translations.fr: Toto aboya joyeusement et courut vers la porte d'entrée.
translations.es: Toto ladró alegremente y corrió a la puerta principal.

sentences.text: Dorothy walked to the open door and looked outside.

translations.en: Dorothy walked to the open door and looked outside.
translations.fr: Dorothée marcha vers la porte ouverte et regarda dehors.
translations.es: Dorita caminó hacia la puerta abierta y miró afuera.

sentences.text: She gasped with wonder at the lovely view.

translations.en: She gasped with wonder at the lovely view.
translations.fr: Elle eut le souffle coupé d'admiration devant cette vue magnifique.
translations.es: Se quedó sin aliento ante la hermosa vista.

sentences.text: The country was green, fresh, and full of life.

translations.en: The country was green, fresh, and full of life.
translations.fr: Le pays était vert, frais et plein de vie.
translations.es: El país era verde, fresco y lleno de vida.

sentences.text: Tall trees bore rich fruits of many bright colors.

translations.en: Tall trees bore rich fruits of many bright colors.
translations.fr: De grands arbres portaient des fruits abondants aux couleurs vives.
translations.es: Altos árboles daban frutos ricos de muchos colores vivos.

sentences.text: Lovely birds sang sweet songs among the green branches.

translations.en: Lovely birds sang sweet songs among the green branches.
translations.fr: De jolis oiseaux chantaient de douces chansons parmi les branches vertes.
translations.es: Hermosos pájaros cantaban dulces canciones entre las ramas verdes.

sentences.text: Dorothy saw a group of strange people coming toward her.

translations.en: Dorothy saw a group of strange people coming toward her.
translations.fr: Dorothée vit un groupe d'étranges personnes venir vers elle.
translations.es: Dorita vio a un grupo de personas extrañas venir hacia ella.

sentences.text: They were not tall like grown men in Kansas.

translations.en: They were not tall like grown men in Kansas.
translations.fr: Ils n'étaient pas grands comme les hommes adultes du Kansas.
translations.es: No eran altos como los hombres adultos de Kansas.

sentences.text: They were small, like children, but dressed like adults.

translations.en: They were small, like children, but dressed like adults.
translations.fr: Ils étaient petits comme des enfants, mais habillés comme des adultes.
translations.es: Eran pequeños, como niños, pero vestidos como adultos.

sentences.text: The men wore round blue hats with tall peaks.

translations.en: The men wore round blue hats with tall peaks.
translations.fr: Les hommes portaient des chapeaux bleus ronds aux pointes hautes.
translations.es: Los hombres llevaban sombreros azules redondos con puntas altas.

sentences.text: An elderly woman walked with the little men.

translations.en: An elderly woman walked with the little men.
translations.fr: Une femme âgée marchait avec les petits hommes.
translations.es: Una mujer anciana caminaba con los hombres pequeños.

sentences.text: She wore a beautiful white gown sprinkled with tiny stars.

translations.en: She wore a beautiful white gown sprinkled with tiny stars.
translations.fr: Elle portait une belle robe blanche parsemée de petites étoiles.
translations.es: Llevaba un hermoso vestido blanco salpicado de estrellas diminutas.

sentences.text: Her hair was white, and her face was kind and gentle.

translations.en: Her hair was white, and her face was kind and gentle.
translations.fr: Ses cheveux étaient blancs, et son visage était doux et bienveillant.
translations.es: Su cabello era blanco y su rostro era amable y dulce.

sentences.text: She walked straight toward Dorothy with a warm smile.

translations.en: She walked straight toward Dorothy with a warm smile.
translations.fr: Elle marcha droit vers Dorothée avec un sourire chaleureux.
translations.es: Caminó directamente hacia Dorita con una sonrisa cálida.

sentences.text: "Welcome to the land of the Munchkins," the woman said.

translations.en: "Welcome to the land of the Munchkins," the woman said.
translations.fr: « Bienvenue au pays des Munchkins », dit la femme.
translations.es: —Bienvenida al país de los Munchkins —dijo la mujer.

sentences.text: "You have killed the Wicked Witch of the East."

translations.en: "You have killed the Wicked Witch of the East."
translations.fr: « Vous avez tué la Méchante Sorcière de l'Est. »
translations.es: —Has matado a la Bruja Mala del Este.

sentences.text: "You have freed these good people from long slavery."

translations.en: "You have freed these good people from long slavery."
translations.fr: « Vous avez libéré ces braves gens d'un long esclavage. »
translations.es: —Has liberado a esta buena gente de una larga esclavitud.

sentences.text: "I have killed nobody," Dorothy replied with surprise.

translations.en: "I have killed nobody," Dorothy replied with surprise.
translations.fr: « Je n'ai tué personne », répondit Dorothée avec surprise.
translations.es: —Yo no he matado a nadie —respondió Dorita con sorpresa.

sentences.text: "My house fell upon her," the Good Witch explained kindly.

translations.en: "My house fell upon her," the Good Witch explained kindly.
translations.fr: « Votre maison est tombée sur elle », expliqua gentiment la Bonne Sorcière.
translations.es: —Tu casa cayó sobre ella —explicó amablemente la Bruja Buena.

sentences.text: Dorothy looked down and saw two feet under the house.

translations.en: Dorothy looked down and saw two feet under the house.
translations.fr: Dorothée baissa les yeux et vit deux pieds sous la maison.
translations.es: Dorita miró hacia abajo y vio dos pies debajo de la casa.

sentences.text: The feet wore pretty silver shoes with pointed toes.

translations.en: The feet wore pretty silver shoes with pointed toes.
translations.fr: Les pieds portaient de jolis souliers d'argent aux bouts pointus.
translations.es: Los pies llevaban bonitos zapatos de plata con puntas afiladas.

sentences.text: The Good Witch took the silver shoes from the dust.

translations.en: The Good Witch took the silver shoes from the dust.
translations.fr: La Bonne Sorcière ramassa les souliers d'argent dans la poussière.
translations.es: La Bruja Buena recogió los zapatos de plata del polvo.

sentences.text: She gave the shining shoes to the little girl.

translations.en: She gave the shining shoes to the little girl.
translations.fr: Elle donna les souliers brillants à la petite fille.
translations.es: Le dio los zapatos brillantes a la niña.

sentences.text: "Put them on your feet," the kind witch said.

translations.en: "Put them on your feet," the kind witch said.
translations.fr: « Mettez-les à vos pieds », dit la gentille sorcière.
translations.es: —Póntelos en los pies —dijo la bruja buena.

sentences.text: "These magic shoes will protect you on your journey."

translations.en: "These magic shoes will protect you on your journey."
translations.fr: « Ces souliers magiques vous protégeront pendant votre voyage. »
translations.es: —Estos zapatos mágicos te protegerán en tu viaje.

sentences.text: "I must return home to Kansas," Dorothy said.

translations.en: "I must return home to Kansas," Dorothy said.
translations.fr: « Je dois rentrer chez moi au Kansas », dit Dorothée.
translations.es: —Debo volver a casa en Kansas —dijo Dorita.

sentences.text: "My Aunt Em and Uncle Henry will worry about me."

translations.en: "My Aunt Em and Uncle Henry will worry about me."
translations.fr: « Ma tante Em et mon oncle Henry vont s'inquiéter pour moi. »
translations.es: —Mi tía Em y mi tío Henry se van a preocupar por mí.

sentences.text: "The road to Kansas is very long," the witch replied.

translations.en: "The road to Kansas is very long," the witch replied.
translations.fr: « Le chemin du Kansas est très long », répondit la sorcière.
translations.es: —El camino a Kansas es muy largo —respondió la bruja.

sentences.text: "You must ask the great Wizard of Oz for help."

translations.en: "You must ask the great Wizard of Oz for help."
translations.fr: « Vous devez demander de l'aide au grand Magicien d'Oz. »
translations.es: —Debes pedir ayuda al gran Mago de Oz.

sentences.text: "Where does the Wizard live?" Dorothy asked quickly.

translations.en: "Where does the Wizard live?" Dorothy asked quickly.
translations.fr: « Où habite le Magicien ? » demanda rapidement Dorothée.
translations.es: ¿Dónde vive el Mago? —preguntó Dorita de prisa.

sentences.text: "He lives far away in the Emerald City," the witch answered.

translations.en: "He lives far away in the Emerald City," the witch answered.
translations.fr: « Il vit loin d'ici, dans la Cité d'Émeraude », répondit la sorcière.
translations.es: —Vive muy lejos, en la Ciudad Esmeralda —respondió la bruja.

sentences.text: "Just follow the road made of yellow brick."

translations.en: "Just follow the road made of yellow brick."
translations.fr: « Suivez simplement la route pavée de briques jaunes. »
translations.es: —Solo sigue el camino de ladrillos amarillos.

sentences.text: The Good Witch kissed Dorothy gently on her forehead.

translations.en: The Good Witch kissed Dorothy gently on her forehead.
translations.fr: La Bonne Sorcière embrassa doucement Dorothée sur le front.
translations.es: La Bruja Buena besó suavemente a Dorita en la frente.

sentences.text: A small round mark remained where the witch had kissed her.

translations.en: A small round mark remained where the witch had kissed her.
translations.fr: Une petite marque ronde resta là où la sorcière l'avait embrassée.
translations.es: Una pequeña marca redonda quedó donde la bruja la había besado.

sentences.text: "No wicked creature will dare to harm you now," she said.

translations.en: "No wicked creature will dare to harm you now," she said.
translations.fr: « Aucune créature malfaisante n'osera vous faire de mal désormais », dit-elle.
translations.es: —Ninguna criatura malvada se atreverá a lastimarte ahora —dijo ella.

sentences.text: The Munchkins bowed low and said farewell with joyful smiles.

translations.en: The Munchkins bowed low and said farewell with joyful smiles.
translations.fr: Les Munchkins s'inclinèrent profondément et lui dirent adieu avec de joyeux sourires.
translations.es: Los Munchkins hicieron una reverencia y se despidieron con sonrisas alegres.

sentences.text: Dorothy put on the silver shoes and prepared to leave.

translations.en: Dorothy put on the silver shoes and prepared to leave.
translations.fr: Dorothée enfila les souliers d'argent et se prépara à partir.
translations.es: Dorita se puso los zapatos de plata y se preparó para partir.
